eidolons.name: Da Capo
eidolons.desc: When the Talent triggers a Follow-Up ATK, there is a 100% base chance to increase the DoT received by the target by 30% for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Fortississimo
eidolons.desc: While Kafka is on the field, DoT dealt by all allies increases by 25%.

eidolons.name: Capriccio
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Recitativo
eidolons.desc: When an enemy target takes DMG from the Shock status inflicted by Kafka, Kafka additionally regenerates 2 Energy.

eidolons.name: Doloroso
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Leggiero
eidolons.desc: The Shock state inflicted on the enemy target by the Ultimate, Technique, or the Talent-triggered Follow-Up ATK has a DMG multiplier increase of 156% and lasts 1 turn(s) longer.

basic.name: Midnight Tumult
basic.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {0}% of Kafka's ATK to a one designated enemy.

skill.name: Caressing Moonlight
skill.desc:
Deals Lightning DMG equal to {0}% of Kafka's ATK to a target enemy and Lightning DMG equal to {2}% of Kafka's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.
If the target enemy is currently receiving DoT, all DoTs currently placed on that enemy immediately produce DMG equal to {1}% of their original DMG.

ult.name: Twilight Trill
ult.desc:
Deals Lightning DMG equal to {0}% of Kafka's ATK to all enemies, with a 100% base chance for enemies hit to become Shocked and immediately take DMG from their current Shock state, equal to {2}% of its original DMG. Shock lasts for 2 turn(s).
While Shocked, enemies receive Lightning DoT equal to {1}% of Kafka's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

talent.name: Gentle but Cruel
talent.desc: After Kafka's teammate uses Basic ATK on an enemy target, Kafka immediately launches Follow-Up ATK and deals Lightning DMG equal to {0}% of her ATK to that target, with a 100% base chance to inflict Shock equivalent to that applied by her Ultimate to the attacked enemy target, lasting for 2 turns. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per turn.

technique.name: Mercy Is Not Forgiveness
technique.desc: Immediately attacks all enemies within a set range. After entering battle, deals Lightning DMG equal to 50% of Kafka's ATK to all enemies, with a 100% base chance to inflict Shock equivalent to that applied by her Ultimate on every enemy target for 2 turn(s).

ability_1.name: Torture
ability_1.desc: When the Ultimate is used, enemy targets will now receive DMG immediately from all currently applied DoT sources instead of just receiving DMG immediately from the currently applied Shock state.

ability_2.name: Plunder
ability_2.desc: If an enemy is defeated while Shocked, Kafka additionally regenerates 5 Energy.

ability_3.name: Thorns
ability_3.desc: The base chance for target enemies to be Shocked by the Ultimate, the Technique, and the Talent-triggered Follow-Up ATK increases by 30%.

basic.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {0}% of Kafka's ATK to one designated enemy.

Deals Lightning DMG equal to {0}% of Kafka's ATK to one designated enemy and Lightning DMG equal to {2}% of Kafka's ATK to adjacent targets.
If the designated enemy or the adjacent targets are currently afflicted with DoT, all DoTs currently placed on those enemies immediately produces DMG equal to {1}% or {3}% of the original DMG.

While Shocked, enemy targets receive Lightning DoT equal to {1}% of Kafka's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

This effect can trigger up to 2 time(s), 1 of which can be regained at the end of Kafka's turn.

technique.desc: Immediately attacks all enemies within a set range. After entering combat, deals Lightning DMG equal to 50% of Kafka's ATK to all enemies, with a 100% base chance to inflict Shock (equivalent to that applied by her Ultimate) on every enemy target for 2 turn(s).

ability_1.name: Torture
ability_1.desc: When an ally target's Effect Hit Rate is 75% or higher, Kafka increases that target's ATK by 100%.

ability_2.name: Plunder
ability_2.desc: If an enemy target is defeated while Shocked, Kafka additionally regenerates 5 Energy.

ability_3.name: Thorns
ability_3.desc: After using Ultimate, restores the triggerable count of Talent's Follow-Up ATK by 1. And the Talent's Follow-Up ATK can cause all DoTs debuffs currently on the target to immediately produce DMG equal to 80% of the original DMG.

lightCones.name: Lies Dance on the Breeze
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's SPD by 18%. After the wearer uses an attack, there's a 120% base chance to inflict "Bamboozle" on every enemy. While under "Bamboozle", enemies have their DEF decreased by 16% for 2 turns. If the wearer's SPD is higher or equal to 170, there's a 120% base chance to inflict "Theft" on every enemy. While under "Theft", enemies have their DEF decreased by 8% for 2 turns. When "Bamboozle" or "Theft" is repeatedly inflicted, only the recently inflicted instance takes effect.

lightCones.name: Before the Tutorial Mission Starts
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's Effect Hit Rate by 20%/25%/30%/35%/40%. When the wearer attacks enemies that have reduced DEF, regenerates 4/5/6/7/8 Energy.

lightCones.name: Those Many Springs
lightCones.description: Increases Effect Hit Rate by 60%/70%/80%/90%/100%. After the wearer uses Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate to attack, there is a 60% base chance to inflict "Unarmored". While in the Unarmored state, target receives 10%/12%/14%/16%/18% increased DMG for 2 turns. If the target is under a DoT inflicted by the wearer, there's a 60% chance to upgrade "Unarmored" to the "Cornered" state, which increases the DMG the target receives by 14%/16%/18%/20%/22%, lasting for 2 turns. During this, the wearer can't inflict "Unarmored" on the target.

relicSets.name: Eagle of Twilight Line
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases Wind DMG by 10%. 4-pc: After the wearer uses their Ultimate, their action is Advanced Forward by 25%.

planarSets.name: Lushaka, the Sunken Seas
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by 5%. If the wearer is not the first character in the team lineup, then increase the ATK of the first character in the team lineup by 12%.

teams.name: Kafka F2P Team
teams.description: This F2P (Free to Play) Team for Kafka focuses on applying DoT and buffing her Speed. Asta is a nice Support since she provides ATK% and Speed buffs while also being able to apply Burn on enemies.

teams.name: Kafka DoT Team
teams.description:
A standard Kafka team will require an additional DoT character, one support character, and one healer or shielder.

You can also Kafka with two other DoT units, which will be especially effective with Hysilens on the team.

lore.description: On the Interastral Peace Corporation's wanted list, Kafka's record only shows her name and a note about her "interest in collecting coats." Little is known about this Stellaron Hunter aside from her being one of "Destiny's Slave" Elio's most trusted members. In order to achieve Elio's envisioned future, Kafka gets to work.
stories: "Kafka, female human. Hails from New Babylon of Pteruges-V. Core member of the Stellaron Hunters, the next-in-command of 'Destiny's Slave.' Responsible for the following infractions: The Pier Point Incursion, two counts; The Pier Point Heist; The Trovys Disappearance; The Stellaron events of Jemorse, Bayjhana, Shilla-39C, Ulmora, 7-Midville, Loar-51, and Dro'a; Cyber attacks against Pier Point, four counts; Cyber attacks against Planet Screwllum; Cyber attacks against Herta Space Station; The Jepella Rebellion. Suspected to be related to the following infractions: The Stellaron events of Sich-Lala, Inupeis, Oun-G7, Zukov, Lidovia, Illily, Attouine, Buhayama. Wanted Level: Highest. Dead or alive." — Wanted Order by the Interastral Peace Corporation

"...Due to the investigation's needs, the suspect's basic information is published as follows: Suspect Kafka (Wanted Serial No.: L933012000020002010004), female, outworld individual, age unknown; height about 170 centimeters, average body size. She had been spotted draped with a black jacket and wearing a white collared shirt inside, a pair of tight-fitting dark shorts, purple pantyhose, and a pair of sunglasses on her head. The suspect has been reported to be connected to multiple non-natural disasters occurring on the Luofu in the recent past. She is currently at large, and is now publicly wanted on the Luofu. Any department and unit who detected said suspect are encouraged to contact the local Cloud Knights. At the same time, we encourage the suspect to turn herself in and to not take any chances." — Luofu Wanted Order (revoked)

"...This woman's name is Kafka, a new Hunter without any information on file, and belongs to no particular organization. She has an ability called Spirit Whisper that allows her to hypnotically manipulate others through language. Recently, she has appeared in Riverland, New Babylon. She was seen communicating with its overchief, Shilde, and absconded with him in witness of 143 people. She then made an appearance at a clothing store and stole a black jacket, two white shirts, and a red dress with 6 witnesses. After that, she was seen by 28 people at an old music record store where she purchased nothing. Before she emerged at the Riverland Guard Station to claim her rewards, she was spotted at the central park with 2695 citizens present. We want Kafka's head, as her lethal crimes cannot go unpunished." — Wanted Order by the Pteruges-V Devils

"...Go to Pteruges-V and locate an abandoned building at coordinates 135:7372124, 271:6372711. Enter it. There is an untouched canned drink under the window sill on the first floor. Take it. Wait until 11:12 AM on Wednesday and place the can at the entrance of the building. Kafka will appear 2 minutes later. There is a chance she will stop to investigate the can. Then, take the chance to throw this ball at her feet. I will take over and converse with her from there. There is also a chance that Kafka will ignore the can. In that case, just throw the ball away. You will die, but death will come for everyone. As for the future that you yearn for - I will realize it." — Wanted Order by Destiny's Slave
